source_harness_qualification: The first overlay incorrectly treated CompileBlueprintIR as the whole validity gate. Worker/private Free pass schema compilation but are refused by service validation. Its two subcase failures (four fail events incl. parent/package) and observations are retained as excluded harness evidence. Corrected overlay calls actual ValidateBlueprint and separately records compiler validity, validation errors and normalized/estimated plans.
